name: android_tap
description: Taps one point: once (default), twice with taps: 2 (e.g. zoom or seek a video), or press and hold with holdMs (e.g. a context menu). Prefer android_click_element when the element is in the UI tree. Give the point as x/y, xRatio/yRatio, or xPixel/yPixel (units may be mixed per axis); one form is required.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

x.description: Screen fraction when both values of the pair are within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels.

y.description: Screen fraction when both values of the pair are within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels.

xRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

yRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

xPixel.description: Physical pixels, even when 0-1 (wins over the raw value).

yPixel.description: Physical pixels, even when 0-1 (wins over the raw value).

intervalMs.description: Double tap: gap between taps in ms (default 120).

holdMs.description: Press and hold this long in ms (long press).

verifyChange.description: Optional. If true, inspects UI hierarchy before and after tap (~300ms window) to verify whether the gesture caused a detectable UI state change.

verifyDelayMs.description: Optional wait duration in milliseconds before capturing post-tap hierarchy (default 300ms for animation settlement).
